## Outcome

What user-facing or release-maintenance outcome does this change deliver?

## Accuracy boundary

Which accepted release evidence or public source supports the change? What does this change intentionally not claim?

## Verification

- [ ] `python scripts/verify_repository.py` passes.
- [ ] Release filenames, byte lengths, SHA-256 values, tag URLs, and schema values remain synchronized.
- [ ] New or changed instructions were followed from a clean user perspective.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, invitation packages, participant bearers, recovery material, or private task data are included.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes were reported privately when appropriate.
